describe: The image shows three side-by-side square panels, each with a peasant figure. The left panel is red-brown with the bright yellow label CAPTURED at the top, and its figure is wrapped in rope. The middle olive panel is labelled RETURN, and its figure has both hands raised near the head. The right green panel is labelled SAFE, and its figure holds one hand up near the chest. Colours are muted red, olive and green with moderate contrast.
